name: loreforge
description: LoreForge provides a main entrypoint, focused workflows, and conventions for operating LLM-wiki style expert-owned domain knowledge bases.

interface.longDescription: LoreForge helps agents use one entrypoint to resolve config, capture, routing, and write policy; query existing knowledge; capture web and document sources; update durable pages; run domain checks; and keep agent-local experience in memory systems such as pamem.
defaultPrompt: Use LoreForge to route this source.
Ingest this source into my LoreForge wiki.
Run a check on this LoreForge domain.
